attributes.context: This provision appears in Article 2 Jurisdiction, which defines covered employees as those engaged in receiving, handling, cutting, selling, processing, wrapping, or displaying meat, requires market work to be performed by bargaining unit members, and states that cutting of retail fresh meat will continue in the market.

extraction_text: It is understood that nothing herein will prevent the company from bringing in pre-cut meats, provided no employees may be laid off or have their hours reduced as a direct result of the operation of this provision.
